Door Pivot Hinges

Pivot Hinges rotate in openings in the floor and the top of the door frame. Also referred to as a double-acting floor hinge. We have a large selection of door pivot hinges made from quality manufactures including Bommer, Deltana, Global Door Controls, and Door Control Services. Our selection includes offset door pivot hinges, center hung door pivots, spring pivots and gravity door pivots.
